scope: Ogg framing (`owned_ogg`), Vorbis chain EOS (`owned_ogg_vorbis`), and multi-track Opus track-index reporting (`owned_ogg_opus` / `OggOpusAudioReader`)

findings.issue: Ogg::parse ignores non-zero reserved bits in header_type_flag (flags & !0x07 != 0), ignores CONTINUES (0x01) on 0-segment pages when no packet is open, and enters MissingPrefix instead of refusing when CONTINUES is set on a mid-stream page after audio packets have already completed cleanly.
findings.fix: Reject pages with flags & !(CONTINUES | BEGINS | ENDS) != 0, reject 0-segment pages with CONTINUES when !at_open.pending.is_open(), and reject mid-stream pages with CONTINUES when !at_open.pending.is_open() and chains[at_open.chain].packets.len() > 2 while preserving joined-stream initial fragment handling and valid 0-segment continuation bridge pages.

findings.issue: owned_ogg_vorbis::Program::from_ogg does not verify that each non-final chain in a chained Vorbis program has ended == true before the next chain begins, unlike owned_ogg_opus::Program and owned_ogg_audio_program::Program.

owned_ogg_opus::Program does not store selected_track or expose audio_track_index(), and OggOpusAudioReader does not implement AudioStream::audio_track_index(), returning the default 0 even when track 1 is opened via open_track(..., 1).
findings.fix: Store selected_track: nth in owned_ogg_opus::Program, expose Program::audio_track_index(&self) -> usize, and forward AudioStream::audio_track_index(&self) -> usize in OggOpusAudioReader.
